design_brief: A warm cafe poster featuring elegant Art Deco-inspired geometric framing with subtle maple leaf influences expressed through clean line-art patterns. Use a high-contrast composition on a soft textured background that remains crisp and printable, creating a cozy autumn atmosphere with balanced negative space for Wi-Fi information.
color_direction: warm amber and cream tones with deep charcoal accents, remaining strong in grayscale reproduction
font_mood: elegant geometric sans-serif with a soft handcrafted warmth
